policy.seed_basis: REQ-011 evidence-only bootstrap: sole issue/PR author and repo owner across all discoverable history at first firing (public repo, no external filings observed) — never a guessed second author.
policy.standing_rule_note: RULED by kimgranlund 2026-08-08 (host AskUserQuestion round): an unknown author's first issue/PR waits in the triage queue for an explicit allow — fail-closed, one-time friction per new person. Supersedes the 2026-08-08 OPEN GAP note.
